application.local_argument: Splitting at2 implies D is odd. For odd fundamental D, O_K=Z[(1+sqrt(D))/2], whose defining polynomial is X^2-X+(1-D)/4. Splitting modulo2 requires (1-D)/4 even, hence D=1 mod8. Thus D is neither -3 nor -4 and O_K units are ±1.
application.twist_map: The twist E_i^D is the curve obtained from D y^2=x^3+A x+B after a rational Weierstrass change; over K, (x,y) maps to (x,sqrt(D)y) on E_i. This is the character twist occurring in BFH and the factorization L(E_i/K,s)=L(E_i,s)L(E_i^D,s).
application.Heegner_trace_map: With the same modular parametrization phi:X_0(N_i)->E_i sending infinity to O, P_K=Tr_{H/K}(phi(x)) in GZ V.2 is Gross y_K=Tr_{K_1/K}(phi(x_1)); H=K_1 is the Hilbert class field. The ideal chosen above N_i changes this trace only up to sign and torsion, preserving nonzero height.
